name: Minor Planet Center API
tagline: Official IAU orbits, observations, and designations for minor planets
description: The International Astronomical Union’s Minor Planet Center (MPC) provides web services and data endpoints for near-Earth objects, minor planets, and related designations. Developers can query orbital elements, observations, and identification data used by the professional astronomy community. Coverage includes NEOs and other small-body catalogs maintained under IAU authority.

auth.details: No authentication required for public web service endpoints (confirm against current docs).

use_cases: look up orbital elements for a minor planet by designation
